images.alt: Line drawings of hands splitting bark fibre and rolling two strands into twine on the thigh
images.caption: Making fibre twine, step by step: splitting the fibre (1–2), rolling two strands together down the thigh (6–7) and joining in new fibre (10–11). Roth drew the method as he saw it used across North Queensland.
images.credit: Drawing: W. E. Roth, North Queensland Ethnography Bulletin 1 (1901), Plate II
